summary.text: Elizabeth Burrows is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont State Senate in the Windsor District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She currently represents Windsor-1 in the Vermont House of Representatives, which she joined in January 2021, and is not seeking re-election to that seat.

paragraphs.text: Burrows lives in West Windsor, Vermont, and her career experience includes work in various editorial roles and founding Pozor Magazine.
She took office in the Vermont House on January 6, 2021, and served on the House Health Care Committee during 2021-2024.
